impact: runCrossReview sends the entire diff in one turn — a diff large enough to need chunking in the main review will likely fail the adjudication turn. runAdjudicate swallows any failure into all-undefined adjudications, so "deliberate-deep ran but adjudication failed" is indistinguishable from findings that were never adjudicated. Cheap fix: add a crossReviewFailed { by, reason } marker to the deliberation block; larger fix: chunk or truncate the cross-review subject.
title: Cross-review round is unchunked and its failure is invisible
